name: Dinner Above the Greenhouse
prompt: Section a terraced residential block to reveal kitchen balconies stacked above a market garden. A dumbwaiter carries baskets up to the cooks and a second shaft brings peelings down to the compost beds.

name: Rain Has Neighbours
prompt: Catch rain in a petal-shaped roof cistern and pass it down a stepped sequence of laundry courts, reed beds and fish tanks. Residents share a stair beside the visible route of the water.

name: The Orchard Lift
prompt: Make a compact inhabited tower around a slow vertical carousel of fruit trees. A ripe tree has arrived at a communal picking balcony as a freshly pruned tree ascends into sunlight.

name: The House That Mends Itself
prompt: Open a cutaway through homes above a brickworks that reuses damaged masonry. Show old bricks descending a chute, fresh blocks rising on a hoist and one family watching its balcony parapet being rebuilt.

name: The Warm Stair
prompt: Build apartments beside a glass-sided communal bakery. Copper heat pipes spiral up a planted stair to drying cupboards and a rooftop seed nursery; show occupied rooms at three distinct heights.
